summary: Thin __thiscall scalar wrapper: reads the DWORD member one element past this (this + 1) through FieldAccessor and returns that value plus the constant 11. The object is not modified. Callers sub_585870 and DecompressionDecode consume the resulting scalar.

operations.description: Call FieldAccessor on the object pointer advanced by one DWORD (this + 1) to read the member; the returned value feeds the arithmetic below.
Add the constant 11 to the field value returned by FieldAccessor.
Return the computed sum (field value + 11) to the caller.

unresolved: Semantic role of the +11 constant and of the DWORD field at this + 1 is not determinable from this packet.
Why callers sub_585870 and DecompressionDecode need this derived scalar is undocumented here.
